deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Use an independent council and multisig administrator to hold funds, validate milestones, and oversee disbursement.
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to continue and expand the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects advancing Vision 2030 KPIs.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The proposer states that KPI dashboard Version 1 enabled public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moved toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1M ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 is described as funding 20 companies with 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 is described as adding 18 new members, funding 14 companies, and achieving 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposer claims the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed on-chain treasury withdrawals transparently.
The proposal names an independent dRep DAO council as administrator, currently including Cardano Yoda and Marco Grendel Moshi with one additional unaffiliated active dRep to be added.
The proposal states administrator-held ADA will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposer states that 354,790 ADA of unused funds was returned to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO, presenting it as a KPI-aligned, smart contract-governed builder funding mechanism with prior funding rounds, administrative controls, milestone-based disbursement, and a stated repayment practice for unused funds.
